**2h**

Made an account in onshape, it's my first time using CAD. I figured out how to make a rough base of the keyboard but I'm still trying to figure out the sizing of the keys (how some keys such as the backspace, spacebar, etc. are bigger than others). I'm also trying to  stagger the keys and build stabilizers but it's proving to be really hard.
